title: Your phone is made of sand: the glowing crystal inside your iPhone's brain
format: Treasure/curiosity series (after #16), HSERIA + mid-CTA (follow) + CTA, second person, rule book v8 (format A), 3 character beats
voice: Kokoro af_heart (voice B); #16 presets unchanged, incl. AWE for the crystal peak

lines.text: Your phone's brain is made of sand.
lines.spoken: Your phone's brain is made of sand.

lines.text: Sand. Inside your phone. Thinking for you.
lines.spoken: Sand. Inside your phone. Thinking for you.

lines.text: Giant factories do this. Never at home.
lines.spoken: Giant factories do this. Never at home.

lines.text: Only three steps. I said that last time.
lines.spoken: Only three steps. I said that last time.

lines.text: First, cook it with coal. Out comes grey metal.
lines.spoken: First, cook it with coal. Out comes grey metal.

lines.text: Still way, way too dirty for a chip.
lines.spoken: Still way, way too dirty for a chip.

lines.text: They clean it, clean it, clean it again.
lines.spoken: They clean it, clean it, clean it again.

lines.text: A gold bar? Four nines pure. This? Nine nines, even eleven.
lines.spoken: A gold bar? Four nines pure. This? Nine nines, even eleven.

lines.text: Now melt it. Hotter than lava.
lines.spoken: Now melt it. Hotter than lava.

lines.text: Dip in a tiny seed. Pull, slowly, slowly.
lines.spoken: Dip in a tiny seed. Pull, slowly, slowly.

lines.text: Spin it one way, the pot the other. Or the other way. Whatever.
lines.spoken: Spin it one way, the pot the other. Or the other way. Whatever.

lines.text: Slower than a snail. About two days.
lines.spoken: Slower than a snail. About two days.

lines.text: Follow. What comes out is huge.
lines.spoken: Follow. What comes out is huge.

lines.text: Out comes one giant glowing crystal, tall as you.
lines.spoken: Out comes one giant glowing crystal, tall as you.

lines.text: Heavy as a piano. Perfect all through.
lines.spoken: Heavy as a piano. Perfect all through.

lines.text: A wire slices it like cheese, thin as a bank card.
lines.spoken: A wire slices it like cheese, thin as a bank card.

lines.text: Polish it to a mirror. Hundreds of phone brains fit on one.
lines.spoken: Polish it to a mirror. Hundreds of phone brains fit on one.

lines.text: Honest part? Not beach sand. Pure quartz rock. Most sand's too dirty.
lines.spoken: Honest part? Not beach sand. Pure quartz rock. Most sand's too dirty.

lines.text: Rock or sand, mostly the same stuff. Still thinking for you.
lines.spoken: Rock or sand, mostly the same stuff. Still thinking for you.

lines.text: Phone hot while charging? Take the case off.
lines.spoken: Phone hot while charging? Take the case off.

lines.text: Did you know your phone started as rock? Yes or no below.
lines.spoken: Did you know your phone started as rock? Yes or no below.
